open.text: Commander. The northern front is yours.

build.text: Build your base. Harvest the ore. Keep the power running.

fight.text: Send in tanks, rockets and artillery, and take the crossing.

fronts.text: Five fronts, from the Iron Pass to the Nordlys Valley.

coop.text: Bring up to seven friends, or hold the fjord alone.

persist.text: And the war keeps going, even after you close your browser.

call.text: Noordheim. Free, in your browser. Deploy now.
